gold: Carcinoma erysipelatoides arising from triple-negative breast cancer

selector.rationale: The presence of multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels supports Carcinoma Erysipelatoides, which is a rare skin manifestation of metastatic cancer.

rejected.label: Radiation Dermatitis
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence linking radiation therapy to the specific skin lesions described

rejected.label: Cutaneous Metastasis
rejected.why: While possible, the specific pattern of erythema and nodules is more characteristic of Carcinoma Erysipelatoides

rejected.label: Inflammatory Breast Cancer
rejected.why: Although it shares some clinical features, the histopathological findings and the context of a previous breast cancer diagnosis make Carcinoma Erysipelatoides a more specific diagnosis
